ABOUT GRABME

An electric mobility ecosystem built as one product.

GRABME connects the passenger journey, driver operations, business programs, Mission Control, and the in-car experience through one EV-first mobility platform.

WHAT GRABME IS

More than an e-taxi booking app.

The public passenger experience is only one layer. GRABME is designed as a connected operating system for electric mobility - riders, drivers, operations, business programs, and the cabin working together.

Electric by default

GRABME is built around an EV-only fleet rather than treating electric vehicles as a secondary ride category.

One passenger journey

Booking, matching, pickup, live ride, completion, ratings, programs, and airport mobility stay connected.

Built for operators

Mission Control gives the mobility business an administrative layer behind the passenger and driver apps.

Connected programs

Corporate, student, membership, and airport experiences reuse the same platform foundations.

Live mobility

Route, ETA, driver, vehicle, and ride state remain central to the active journey.

Connected cabin

GRABME Connect continues the authenticated ride inside supported vehicles with live trip information and cabin experiences.

PRODUCT FAMILY

Ride. Drive. Operate. Connect.

Ride gives passengers the end-to-end mobility experience.

Drive gives drivers the tools to receive and execute rides.

Operate gives GRABME the administrative and dispatch foundation behind the network.

Connect extends the active journey into supported vehicle cabins.

Electric mobility, connected. Built for passengers, drivers, businesses, and the journey inside the vehicle.

RIDE WITH GRABME

Your Passenger experience, from destination to arrival.

A compact EV booking flow with ride choice, scheduling, pickup, payments, matching, live trip visibility, programs, completion, and rating.

PASSENGER EXPERIENCE

Compact where it matters. Clear at every decision.

The booking experience keeps the vehicle, price, journey details, ride categories, timing, and payment context close together so the passenger can make a decision without jumping between screens.

Ride choice

Standard, Priority, Premium and Luxury EV options.

Timing

Ride now or choose a scheduled journey.

Live context

Pickup, route, ETA, driver and vehicle information.

Completion

Trip history, rating and repeat-ride context.

EV RIDE CATEGORIES

Choose the journey that fits.
Standard

Everyday electric mobility

A straightforward EV ride for everyday trips and daily transportation.

Priority

Faster matching

A higher-priority ride option for passengers who want quicker matching when available.

Premium

More comfort

A comfort-focused electric ride category for passengers who want an upgraded journey.

Luxury

Executive travel

A premium vehicle experience for executive trips, events, and special journeys.

Airport

Travel-ready mobility

A dedicated airport journey with travel details, pickup coordination, and suitable EV selection.

Students

Verified student mobility

Student-oriented access and program benefits within the main GRABME passenger experience.

PASSENGER FLOW

One continuous ride lifecycle.

STEP 1

Choose your destination

Search a destination and review the journey from your current pickup context.

STEP 2

Choose how to travel

Select Standard, Priority, Premium, Luxury, Airport, or an eligible program journey.

STEP 3

Ride now or schedule

Request immediately or choose a scheduled ride when you want to travel later.

STEP 4

Confirm pickup & payment

Review pickup and pay with a supported passenger payment method.

STEP 5

Match with a driver

Follow searching and matched states as GRABME assigns an available EV driver.

STEP 6

Follow the live trip

See driver, vehicle, ETA, route, trip progress, completion, and rating.

PAY YOUR WAY

Payment stays inside the ride.

Passenger payment options are part of the booking experience. Driver settlement and cash-out workflows are handled separately in driver operations.

Visa

Card payment inside the passenger journey.

Mastercard

Card payment inside the passenger journey.

Wish Money

Supported digital payment option for riders.

Cash

Pay the driver in cash where enabled.

READY TO RIDE?

Your EV journey starts in GRABME.

GRABME CONNECT

Your ride, inside the cabin.

GRABME Connect extends the active ride into the vehicle with passenger login, live trip visibility, entertainment, and dedicated cabin modes.

Explore Connect
Get GRABME

Designed & built by MetaHaus.

CURRENT CONNECT EXPERIENCE

Everything the passenger needs during the active ride.
Passenger Login

Start a ride-linked cabin session so the in-car experience follows the authenticated passenger and active trip.

Live Journey

Keep route progress, destination, ETA, driver details, vehicle details, and trip state visible in the cabin.

Entertainment

Open the current in-car entertainment surface during the journey from the GRABME Connect screen.

Kids Mode

A simplified child-friendly mode for family journeys and a clearer cabin experience.

Work Mode

A focused in-car mode for passengers who want a quieter, more work-oriented journey.

Wi-Fi Portal

Support the connected cabin experience through the in-vehicle GRABME interface and available network connection.

Ride-Linked Safety

Keep core trip, driver, vehicle, and safety information attached to the active ride session.

RIDE-LINKED BY DESIGN

The cabin experience follows the journey.

Connect is not a separate destination. It is the in-car continuation of the GRABME ride, designed around the same passenger, vehicle, driver, and trip lifecycle.

01

Enter the vehicle

The passenger boards a GRABME EV equipped with the current Connect experience.

02

Open GRABME Connect

The cabin screen presents the connected ride surface for the active journey.

03

Continue the ride

Live journey information remains visible while entertainment or a cabin mode can be used.

04

End with the trip

The connected passenger session follows the ride lifecycle and closes with the completed journey.

CONNECTED TO THE RIDE

One passenger experience, from phone to cabin.

The Passenger app owns booking and the active trip. GRABME Connect extends that same journey inside supported vehicles, keeping the cabin experience aligned with the ride rather than creating a second disconnected product.

VEHICLE BOUNDARY

Software-led, vehicle-aware.

GRABME Connect controls the software experience shown on supported in-car devices. Physical vehicle functions remain dependent on the capabilities and authorized interfaces provided by each EV manufacturer.

GRABME CONNECT

Designed & built by MetaHaus.
